$comment: Checker families. A family describes what stays the same across its versions; the version is chosen per run (family@version) and installed into tools/<family>@<version>/ by `pnpm arena tool add`. Fields: package: the npm package installed; versions: the major versions this family covers (a version outside the range belongs to another family, such as typescript 6 under tsc and 7 under tsgo); binary: per <platform>-<arch>, the package holding the native executable and its path inside that package (a platform that is missing means no build is published for it); runtime: 'node' when the executable is a JavaScript file run with the current node, otherwise it is run directly; args: placed before the config arguments, where an {args, versions} entry applies only to that version range (bun check gained --no-script in 1.4.4); project: how the config is passed; plainOutput: one line per diagnostic; listFiles: how it lists its program's files, or null; threads: thread flags as documented by the checker, {n} replaced, or null when it documents none; defaultThreads: what it uses with no thread flag, as documented: a number or 'per-core'; source: where the thread flags are documented.

families.name: tsc
families.description: The JavaScript TypeScript compiler (TypeScript 6 and earlier)
families.source: Single threaded; tsc 6 has no thread option

families.name: tsgo
families.source: tsc --help --all; the default of 4 checkers is stated in the tsc-ts and tsc-rs READMEs

families.name: tsrs
families.description: A Rust port of the TypeScript 7 checker (oxc-project/tsrs)

families.name: tsc-rs
families.description: A Rust port of the TypeScript 7 compiler (pingdotgg/ts-rust)
families.source: pingdotgg/ts-rust README: --checkers is Go's option, default 4

families.name: tsc-ts
families.description: A TypeScript port of tsgo compiled to a native executable (Vercel Labs)
families.source: tsc-ts README: one checker per CPU, up to 16, at least 4

families.name: bun
families.source: bun check --help: one thread per CPU core
